thread:
Rae Morales: Heads up 1 Optimize launch draft is ready for final signoff. Main asks: 1) pick hero variant for A/B test, 2) confirm embargo window + press contact, 3) HubSpot CTA + lead score thresholds. Doc: https://docs.google.com/d/optimize-launch-ab-test

Chris Tan: Link received. I'll run two hero variants (A/B) in the doc and prep UTM'd CTAs for each.

Olivia Park: Hero ideas: A) "Cut inference costskeep quality high." B) "Lower per-token spend, same output." I'll drop both in and add microcopy.

Rae Morales: Nice. Want one more benefit-forward longline for newsletter: "Reduce inference spend while preserving latency and quality."

Ben Soto: Ops ask: include the ops caveat with example throughput table and a short note: "typical internal tests; your mileage may vary". Also send slides link for webinar: https://redwood.com/slides/optimize-webinar

Rae Morales: added ops table and webinar slides link. Webinar host: Ben + AE Samir. Demo clip (GIF) attached in doc; Olivia pls add alt text.

Olivia Park: Alt text: "Demo GIF: Optimize dashboard showing cache hit rate increasing and median latency dropping". Short version for translations included. Also added short social variants for each hero.

Pat Nguyen: Legal quick-pass: flagged the phrase "cut inference costs" — please use "typical" and add a footnote with test harness: model=llama-3-13b, seq_len_p95=512, batching=dynamic, runs=12, hardware=A100-80GB. Avoid absolute claims.

Rae Morales: Updated bench language to: "Typical 2028% per-token cost reduction observed in our internal tests; results vary by model and prompt length." Footnote appended.

crm-bot: HubSpot: use form id 424242. CTA links should include utm_source=blog, utm_medium=post, utm_campaign=optimize_launch_ab. Suggested landing: https://redwood.com/optimize?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=optimize_launch_ab

Chris Tan: For A/B routing, we'll add ?variant=A or ?variant=B to CTAs so we can measure conversion and webinar signups.

Rae Morales: Lead scoring: propose mapping below. Copy to ops once approved.
```
if registered && attended:
  if demo_requested or (survey_score >= 8):
    owner = sales-sdr
    priority = high
  else:
    owner = sales-nurture
elif registered:
  nurture_flow = product_webinar
  tags = [optimize_launch, ab_test]
```

Ben Soto: Ops ok with that. Will ensure webhooks tag variant=A/B and push watched_pct metrics back to HubSpot.

Pat Nguyen: Press embargo: don't send to press until legal clears. Press contact set to press-bot (press-list). Proposed embargo window: embargo lifts 2026-05-12 16:00 PT. Press-bot: please confirm availability for that slot.

press-bot: Confirmed. Will queue press outreach for embargo lift 2026-05-12 16:00 PT and hold list ready.

Olivia Park: Small accessibility note: GIF <3MB, and caption included. Localization sheet added for translations.

Chris Tan: A/B test plan: run variant A/B for 48 hours post-publish, measure CTR -> reg -> attended conversion, then pick winner for pinned share and newsletter.

Rae Morales: Timeline: finish minor edits now, legal final signoff by EOD, CRM/Webhooks ready, press queued behind embargo. If legal ok, we'll publish tomorrow 09:00 PT and start the A/B test. Any blockers?

Pat Nguyen: Quick-pass pending one line change to footnote order. Otherwise ready.

Ben Soto: No blockers. I'll validate webhook metrics and handshake with analytics.

Olivia Park: I'll finalize social assets and short captions for LinkedIn/Twitter/X once hero is chosen.

Rae Morales: Great work team 1 ping me when legal signs off and I'll request the publish slot. :rocket:
